description: In the Dashboard screen, create a GridView or Wrap widget containing four ElevatedButton widgets labeled 'NPK', 'Micro', 'Mix', and 'Water'. Add a 'Stop' button. When a button is pressed, send a POST request to http://192.168.1.2:8000/control/active-bucket with the corresponding label. Update the VideoFeedWidget to display a semi-transparent overlay text showing the 'Current Active Bucket' by fetching the status from the backend every few seconds.
